about: Realistic Morse requests. `target` is what the user pointed at (null: page-wide). `before` runs before the mod and its value is `B` in the checker. `check` is the body of an async function run in the page after the mod is applied; it returns true to pass, anything else (a string) is the failure reason. Helpers are `T` (evals/page-helpers.js). `split: test` cases are held out: run them only for the final report.
